sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Cancellation Application No. - 81 of 2023
Applicant :- Kanti Devi

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Sectt. Lko And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Brij Bhushan Singh,Pranjal Apurva,Sandeep Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard the counsel for the applicant.

2. The bail cancellation application has been filed seeking cancellation of the bail granted by this court on 19.07.2023 in case crime no.328 of 2022 under sections 376, 328 IPC and 67 IT Act, P.S.
Chhapia, District Gonda.
3.

The submission of the counsel for the applicant is that this Court while passing the bail order had Kanti Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66037122/
1 recorded the presence of the counsel for the complainant whereas the counsel who was appointed by the complainant was not present as somebody else has misrepresented himself as the counsel for the complainant.

entities.text: Kanti Devi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further argued that the facts with regard to uploading of nude photographs, which were alleged in the FIR, were not brought to the knowledge of this court while the bail was granted.

It is further argued that after release from the custody, the accused are threatening the applicant and on these grounds, the bail granted by this court should be cancelled.
4.

After hearing the counsel for the applicant and without going into the correctness of the said assertions that he was not present and somebody else misrepresented himself as the counsel for the complainant, I have heard the counsel for the complainant once again.

5. The bail was granted after taking into consideration the fact that the medical report, prima facie,
do not corroborate the prosecution story, the statement of the victim recorded under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. were also noted by this court.

This court also took into the fact that the trial was not proceeding and despite sufficient time having been elapsed, only the charges have been framed and the accused was in pretrial detention for a substantially long time.
Thus, I do not see any reason to interfere with the bail order passed by this court on 19.07.2023.

6. The other grounds taken by the counsel for the applicant with regard to allegations attracting section 67 of the IT Act, the offence under IT Act is punishable for a term up to three years, as such,
even in terms of the detention prescribed under section 67 of the IT Act, the applicant was entitled for the bail.

7. As regards the other allegations that the accused is threatening the applicant, there is no FIR on record to that effect, however, the applicant would be at liberty to approach the appropriate court for grant of protection on her establishing the threat, as alleged in the application.
8. For all the reasoning recorded above, the bail cancellation application is rejected.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 VNP/-
